observations: Edition mismatch: drawings cite 2022 CRC/CALGreen (plus 'UBC' and '2019 Green Code' notes) while shear walls are Tedds NDS2015 / SDPWS with IBC 2018 cl.1605.3.1 combinations, the joist report cites NDS 2018 / ASCE 7-16 and the footing ACI318-14.

Placeholder lateral loads: every shear wall (1W1-1W4, 2W1-2W6) uses the same in-plane W = 35 lbs and Eq = 40 lbs with D = 135 lb/ft, Lf = 100 lb/ft, SDS = 1; utilizations are ~0.01, no building-level wind/seismic analysis is provided.

1W2, 1W4, 2W5 and 2W6 (strength-distribution method) print the Tedds DESIGN WARNING that no deflection/drift check is included; several segments are 'not considered' because h/b exceeds the maximum aspect ratio 3.5.
Drawings reference a 'SHEAR WALL SCHEDULE' and Simpson HTT holdowns, but no shear wall schedule appears in the set; calc hold-down forces are negative (no uplift).
1W1 opening wo1 = 2.833 ft x ho1 = 6.667 ft vs 1st-floor door schedule D1 3'0'' x 7'2'' (likely mismatch; schedule text garbled).
Floor joist report: Sx = 20.70 in³ and Ix = 95.70 in⁴ printed for 2×10 do not match 1.5"×9.25" (21.39 in³ / 98.93 in⁴); span 14 ft is assumed.

Footing calc Ly = 2 ft, h = 18 in, No.4 bars at 6.0 in c/c bottom, f'c = 4000 psi vs drawings (3) #4 EA. W., 24"/12" MIN. footing sections and lap splice schedule f'c = 2500 PSI; footing line loads (2.0 D / 2.5 L / 0.9 Lr kips per ft) are not traced to the shear wall top loads.
extractionNotes: Values copied verbatim from the text dump (no recalculation). Markdown escape backslashes in the dump were removed (e.g. 'Vw\_max' -> 'Vw_max', 'Fc\*' -> 'Fc*'). Keys are the printed Tedds symbols; where a symbol repeats on a sheet the key carries the printed heading context in [brackets] and '#n' for further repeats. 'labels' maps keys to the printed description. Inputs = plain printed values in input blocks; results = computed values (printed with a formula), ratios, and values printed in analysis/design blocks; results.checks = PASS/FAIL lines as printed.
